pick.name: Wise Business
pick.what: Receive USD, EUR, GBP and more via local details
pick.why: Cheap, transparent, available in most countries
pick.free_limits: US: one-time USD 31 setup fee, no monthly fee; USD wire/Swift receive USD 6.11; non-wire USD receipts free; account details in 22 currencies; FX at mid-market plus a variable fee

alts.name: Mercury
alts.why: Free ACH and USD wires for US entities
alts.free_limits: $0 base plan; ACH and domestic wires free per page

alts.name: Skydo (India)
alts.what: Local USD/EUR/GBP collection accounts for Indian exporters, INR in ~1 business day, free FIRA
alts.why: Flat fee + 0% FX markup beats % fees on consulting-size invoices; RBI PA-CB final authorisation (inward) Jan 2026
alts.free_limits: $19 up to $2,000; $29 $2,001-$10,000; 0.3% above $10,000; 0% FX markup; free per-transaction FIRA; no inactivity fee (Skydo's own pages; one page conflicts $19/$29). PA-CB rules cap Rs25 lakh per transaction.

alts.name: Airwallex
alts.what: replaces India-only Skydo as a global runner-up: Explore USD 0, 20+ currencies, FX 0.5% over interbank for majors

candidates.name: PayPal
candidates.verdict: Highest effective cost per earlier research

candidates.name: Direct SWIFT
candidates.verdict: Bank FX margin and intermediary fees

decision: Wise Business is the best overall for getting paid across currencies: local receiving details, mid-market rates, no monthly fee. US entities should use Mercury; Indian freelancers compare Skydo and Razorpay MCA for FIRA and fee slabs by invoice size.

region_notes.India: Wise Business, Skydo (flat fee per invoice, free FIRA) and Razorpay MCA are the usual routes; check each issues e-FIRC/e-BRC. Under FEMA's 2026 export regulations (in force 1 Oct 2026) services export proceeds must be realised within 9 months of invoice (was 15). Verify with a CA.
region_notes.US: Foreign clients usually pay by ACH or wire to a US account; collect W-9 or W-8 forms as relevant. Verify with a professional.
region_notes.EU: SEPA to a local IBAN is cheap; Wise and Revolut provide IBANs.
